notes.title: Update #3 - Forging!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
I'm sorry for being quite for so long, this update took a lot of time. But now it is such as i wanted it to be.
First of all, i believe that now the "1000 Throws"[/b ]Achievement works well, so if you have 1000 throws, just update the game and it will fix itself in the main menu!

Added
Forging minigame
Now you need to craft iron ingots yourself, instead of getting them from forge.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799959/6c735022e06a999bb8c560aa6cbe7d14735a71a3.png

The minigame consists of several steps

Heat the forge with the bellows
Add ore to the crucible
Put it on fire and wait till the ore melts
Go to mold and pour it in

I tried to make it not very time consuming, but a bit challenging.
Right now, you can melt only iron ore, but later i will expand this system with another ores and ingredients.

Fixed

Camera rotation didn't work after fishing
D8 could spawn when leveling up


That's all for this update.

Now about the future. I'll write it down so will have no way to back down
Roadmap

Tavern, finally, i need and want to make it
Skilltree remake - i think it will be RPG-like round tree where you spend points on unlocks
Prop menu remake
Hedge-type fence
Some new decorations
Change "prop" to "decor" :0

And I will be glad to hear your ideas for new buildings or decorations.

Oh, and Winter is coming.
Thanks everyone, have a good time
Cya!

notes.title: Release on the 28th of September
notes.content:
A lot was made for the last months.
The game got UI, saves, settings.
In-game content was updated with new buildings like Farms, Gardens, Fishing Huts.
Though, i had to cut "Adventures" for now, because the base mechanics were not ready to normally integrate it.

Last weeks were spent for fixing major bugs that occured with regress/save and load. Thanks to the community in Discord, they really helped a lot

Yesterday i have added Achievements to Steam, and update those that are in-game

I'll create a nice roadmap in near future, but for now it looks like:

New buildings for better resource usefullness, like Tavern
New minigames - i really want to make "Mine Kart Racing League"
Inventory system for Items, that will be usefull for the "Adventure"


That's the core points of future plan.

Also, there were added localizations, so i would be grateful for feedback and response about languages other than English.

In the end i want to thank everyone who played the demo, joined discord, posted in community hub and made videos - all those actions helped a lot.

We had a pretty long journey and have a longer one in the future!
Thanks!
cya

notes.title: Some news
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!
Long time since last news. 
So, the progress is going. Based on a demo i got pretty nice core mechanics of building and now working on expanding them. Also, spending couple of days per week for making visuals better.

As you could notice, some buildings - Lumber, Barn, bridge, had their "building animations". I have to say, that im unable to keep them, because it's too time consuming in terms of development progress. I would like to expand the gameplay, so i've focused on creating mechanics rather than making those animations. Though, bridge and Shrine animations will stay.

Instead of animations i've finally decided to remake building from scratch and started with Windmill
Right now there are only 4 of 5 levels and level 4 already has roof customization.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799959/823078b3b11d5ab31783fac378c54e12c106685e.png

Also. For food production i've added Gardens, i think it's with apples. Consumes nothing, requires 2 people, produces 0.5 food per grade.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799959/45e06215012db9057c94a63ffeda8b0562f6e290.png

And the new food consumer, tier-2 resource - Farm. Needs 2 people (or 3, don't remember), consumes 2 food per grade, produces 1 leather per grade per MINUTE. 
Yea, i decided to make tier-2 resources not in thousands, but in units, for more control over tier-2 "economics"
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799959/b62c0d5daad04482838d24b191584c040d8b83e9.png
And farm's citizens
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799959/2cfe5ae3f977354506670df45b7b837ef4cd6854.png

Adventures
Finally, with Forge creation in Demo, the era of Adventures started. There will be dungeons, where you send your Hero (previously equipped in Forge) and he gets you items for developing your village. So the overall gameplay loop will not only consist of gaining levels and buying upgrades - some of this upgrades can be accessed through another activities.

Dungeon, by the way
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799959/41e5deec65038cd14bbbff7c63bd3ff1ddcb7290.gif

That's all news for now, i'll come again later with something new C:
Thanks for reading, thanks for playing
cya

notes.title: Enormous Demo Update
notes.content:
Intro
Hello everyone!
Almost 3 weeks after demo release, in that time got a lot of feedback, added some cool things and upgraded the game to the next stage.
First things first.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799959/2fc7a1e5d25e908b5fc2347c23360f89f1253758.jpg
Progression

 Added Level system
 Reworked Regress system 
 New conditions for opening new buildings

So, about Levels. As always - for your actions you get XP -> Level up -> New possibilities
Each building grade gives 10-50XP based on rarity, 5 XP for collectibles on the map.
After building a Shrine, you get access to Regress button (you don't need to buy it as it was before).
Regress is free, but you abandon your Village, get XP, gems, and access to Regress Shop
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799959/3d359d17bf117baf5a8aaba2a8320860c85a2e37.png.

Regress
As i said earlier, Regress takes away your Village, but you are able to buy upgrades in Regress Shop. There are dices+throws and Progression Tree. Right now i've added some upgrades as examples for 5/10/15 and 20th level. Though i think i will rework this system a bit before EA, so it will not bring so much emotional damage.
Also, in these upgrades you now can "open" new types of buildings.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799959/b68d9f217c2a79b99dbb631f846c41099b23b1ec.png

Tutorial
Yea, added some sort of tutorial, that will help at the start, there are buttons in main menu and in game menu (esc button, top right corner).

Improvements

Pror eraser - now it's possible to erase fences, bridges and different small props.
Visual interpretation of getting XP
Save and load system. Not fully implemented, but it will save your "Number Progress" - level, XP and multipliers. Village saving later, sorry
Reworked prices a bit.
Added limits for physical throw + time till it stops (10 seconds after the throw and you get your result
New UI hints, especially for building placement
Nice "Level up" text C:
Main menu time is now synchronized with your PC time (sorry for invasion)
Animation for Dice on the Shrine after build


Summary
It was pretty tough but awesome to work on this update, i really apprectiate Your feedback and thanks to the guys on Youtube for some cool videos and comments. They are really warm and helpful!

Soon i'll make a roadmap, because the next steps are seen clearly now, so i can write them down and share em with you.
Thanks again
See you on the Steam Fest!
